nom: Bliss Incredi-Peel Glycolic Resurfacing Facial Pads - 15 Count - Non-Greasy

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive, including one who calls hers extremely reactive to sun and wind, mostly report the pads as gentle and effective with less redness; one reviewer who explicitly says she does not have sensitive skin, however, had a severe burning reaction that left every other product stinging afterward too.
segments.dry: The one reviewer with dry skin reports her sunspots started fading and her skin looked glowier after using it a few times a week.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s, and 60s report smoother skin tone, softened fine lines, and faded age spots, including on sun-damaged skin on the forearms, with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother, clearer, more glowing skin and softened fine lines with regular use, including one who saw premature age spots and crepey texture fade from sun-damaged forearm skin; one reviewer, however, saw no noticeable difference at all.
concerns.redness: The one reviewer who addresses this directly reports less redness around her nose with consistent use.
concerns.barrier: Reactions vary widely: many reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, describe the pads as gentle, with only mild, brief stinging; a minority, including one who says she doesn't normally have sensitive skin, report a severe reaction with burning and peeling that made every other product sting afterward too.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers using this for dark spots, sunspots, or discoloration, including one with PCOS-related discoloration on dark skin, report visible fading within a few uses; one reviewer, however, developed a new dark spot between her eyes that had not faded days later.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, including one whose pregnancy acne improved and one with eczema whose flaky, painful patches by her nose cleared within three days; one reviewer treating pregnancy acne noted an initial increase in breakouts in the first week before her skin cleared.

extraits.texte: Followed instructions and still ended up with a discoloration between my eyes on the day of a wedding. I only use the pads for a week at a time and only at night. Then I would give my skin a break for a few weeks and do it again for a week. I used to think this was a great product and I even recommended it to my friends. Now I’m not so sure this is safe. I hope the spot will fade. The picture was taken on day 3 of when it first appeared. I want to say be careful, but I was and it still happened.

I used ONE “treatment” and my skin is peeling, but what’s worse is the BURNING! ANYTHING I put on my face BURNS! Even my No7 Hydration Mask (cream). All of my washes, creams etc burn like fire! The kicker is, I do not have sensitive skin! I tolerate just about everything I’ve tried. Also, I have never written a review, so, that tells you just how much my skin is suffering! Lucky you if your skin doesn’t react the same way, but, you’ve been warned!
Not sure that I've seen any difference. Probably won't be reordering.

These have made a really huge difference in my pregnancy acne! I had acne as a teenager, but have always had very clear skin as an adult, so was baffled by what to do when acne cropped up in my second trimester. It seemed like my skin felt thicker—like the dead cells weren’t removing themselves fast enough—but any sort of scrub or manual exfoliation just irritated my skin. I started using these two nights a week, then upped it to three nights a week after a month. I did notice an increase in acne after the first week, but I read that glycolic acid can bring existing acne to the surface—sort of a “purging action,” I guess. So, I stuck with it, and I’m so glad I did. While I still have some tiny bumps, my skin is MUCH clearer and more glowy. No more big, painful, stuck-under-the-skin spots. At first, I wished the pads were a bit smaller, as the size/amount of product is really too much for just your face. Then I realized I could A) cut the pads in half, put half back in the foil packet, put the packet in a zipper baggie and save it (I wouldn’t recommend this if you’re skipping multiple days in between applications, since the pad does dry out a little), or B) apply it to my neck and chest as well, which is what I have been doing, and it’s really been smoothing out the skin there, too. Very glad I took a chance on these, as I’m not one to try many new skin care products!

So I was terrified to go for an actual peel at the spa and I saw some great reviews on this product. When I purchased it, I used to three times a week, wiped it over my dry skin, avoiding the eye area. After the second time, I noticed my sunspots starting to disappear, and my face having an amazing glow to it in the morning. This morning I was on a zoom call and someone actually mentioned how wonderful my skin looked. I will continue using this product.

This product is perfect. I first bought it in a Bliss Spa and then I bought it on Amazon for a bit less. My last purchase was at Costco for significantly less but alas they don't carry it anymore online, so I will continue to purchase it here until they do. I have very mild acne scarring and this helps with that. I'm also in my early 40's and smooths out and refines my fine lines. It helps keep my skin clear and fresh. It just responds really well to this product yet it's so gentle. Men have thicker skin and most products are geared towards women so I'm glad this is effective but not harsh. I wash my face, tone and then put this on before serum and moisturizing. After my face and neck, I use what's left of the pad on my forearms which have mild sun damage from years of tennis and running. The premature age spots and crepey feel of my forearm skin has gone away. It may be the biggest benefit of this product. I was truly floored. I hate how expensive this is, but it's so effective that I won't stop. It's the most effective part of my skincare regimen.
